investigation: credential isolation boundary from frozen distribution source only

conclusion.statement: A separate CODEX_HOME and Electron userData do not establish credential isolation. Frozen JS confirms shell environment import, inherited app-server environment, optional external websocket/local-daemon transports, and a secret-auth-storage config gate. Which mechanism caused the already signed-in runtime observed by the root agent has not been proven.

hypotheses.name: inherited or reimported websocket/CLI environment
hypotheses.verification: Observe variable names only and actual selected executable/transport with values redacted. A websocket to an existing server can ignore local storage isolation.

hypotheses.name: shell environment restored credentials or runtime override
hypotheses.verification: Use test OS account with empty shell initialization and no credentials, or inspect instrumentation emitting only env key names after shell import. Do not print values.

hypotheses.name: native keyring/encrypted authentication storage
hypotheses.verification: Confirm selected native auth backend and migration branch from matching public source or controlled test account. Binary strings alone cannot prove keychain read or home scoping.

hypotheses.name: independent application accidentally routes to existing instance
hypotheses.verification: Verify process executable and current userData/CODEX_HOME paths; no app management performed here.

knownControls.name: CODEX_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_PATH
knownControls.purpose: separate Electron storage and preserve initial CODEX_HOME across startup shell import

knownControls.name: --user-data-dir=<task path>
knownControls.purpose: demo launch uses this with explicit userData env; auth anonymity not guaranteed

knownControls.name: CODEX_APP_SERVER_FORCE_CLI=1
knownControls.purpose: force stdio CLI instead of configured websocket/local-daemon routes; does not disable native credentials

knownControls.name: CODEX_CLI_PATH=<frozen bin/codex>
knownControls.purpose: pin app-server executable; shell import may override it, so verify resolved executable

knownControls.name: -c cli_auth_credentials_store="file" and -c features.secret_auth_storage=false
knownControls.purpose: candidate native configuration for separate file storage; neither selection precedence nor suppression of credential migration is verified; do not treat as proven anonymous mode

conditions: Use a test OS account whose shell startup and OS credential store contain no personal Codex/ChatGPT authentication; CODEX_HOME alone cannot isolate os.userInfo or OS keychain.

Launch the frozen application executable directly with an explicit environment allowlist rather than inheriting parent process.env. Include required graphical/runtime variables, absolute PATH, task CODEX_HOME and task CODEX_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_PATH.
Set CODEX_APP_SERVER_FORCE_CLI=1 and CODEX_CLI_PATH to frozen resources/codex-cli/bin/codex; ensure they survive shell-env initialization. Use new --user-data-dir path.
Verify selected app-server transport is stdio and selected CLI is frozen copy before attributing behavior to that baseline.
Begin with empty task-owned config and storage; observe login screen/account absent without reading any auth.json or token values.
If file storage/secret storage overrides are tested, record actual argv and backend selection with secrets redacted; current investigation does not prove these options stop native auto-import.
